hard_target: For the already constructed actual proper rank-two witness, prove its normalized actual proper cup/trace and infinity orientation and match the saved particular Weierstrass pairing, generic classes, canonical Frobenius and inverse-transpose direction.

input_types.prime: p congruent to 13 or 19 modulo24; 2,3 units; nu in Z_p with nu^2=-3; ordered split branches

input_types.specified_classes: omega=dx/(2y); eta=x omega as corrected proper Cech cocycle with h=y/x=-1/z and beta=-h=1/z; g=[(1/z)omega]
input_types.coefficient_maps: specified actual model maps and reductions including nonflat reductions; each completion via its own already proved quasi-isomorphism

outputs.proof: complete AppendixT and section4: finite-flat monic-quadratic Hom counit -> actual P1 Verdier trace; not assigned functional

outputs.name: normalized_pairing

outputs.proof: compose the independently fixed actual trace with the displayed actual cup

outputs.proof: canonical crystalline multiplicativity + actual cup and detM=p; no cancellation of p

outputs.proof: actual geometric base change, not equal-rank identification

outputs.proof: differentiation of the previously proved actual horizontality; inverse is linearized, not additive substitution-surjectivity

outputs.proof: reuse the exact actual graph/basis arrow; no new functional or full-relative claim

failure_or_excluded_domains: A different proper second-kind class eta plus a holomorphic shift must transport the basis and constants explicitly.
Ordered Cech opens, support-cone shift, Chern transition direction and dualizing adjunction sign must all be retained.
The isogeny matrix called J in an older source is not J_alt; the graph-adapted e P^-T basis has pairing scale1/12.
No equality of p and (p,t) topologies or their independently specified sites is claimed.
No identification of lim_n(A/p^n)[t^-1] with A[t^-1] or Q_p((t)); no Rlim/t-inversion interchange.
The actual finite smooth-locus maps restrict canonically; coefficient extension of their integral matrix is specified. No extra rigid/convergent generic theorem.
The lift theta(t)=t^p is not tau(t)=(1+t)^p-1 from ambient r^p.
No independent unnamed formal ringed topos/frame identity, full rank-four relative extension, off-diagonal constants, isogeny/dagger/gluing comparison or original global functional.
No global sign multiplier, LC A-C/wholeD, Native vote, formal Result, Task execution, Tool/Foundation/WorkingTruth registration or parent closure.
